description.value: Donair Castle is a fast-food shop on Lougheed Highway in the Lower Mainland specializing in donairs and kebab-style sandwiches. Located along a busy highway corridor, it offers a quick hot meal option for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. The cuisine — hearty, portable, and calorie-dense — makes it a practical refuelling stop on longer touring routes.
